name: AIO (weekly 24-hr infusion 5-FU/LV)
lineOfTherapy: any line of therapy, if not previously given

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: Source (DeVita 12th ed., line 123467, citing Kohne et al., 1998): 'LV 500 mg/m2 over 2 hr, followed by 5-FU 2,600 mg/m2 over 24 hr, repeated weekly.' Weekly regimen; day shown as 1 of each 7-day cycle.

drugs.name: 5-Fluorouracil
drugs.notes: Source (DeVita 12th ed., line 123472, citing Kohne et al., 1998): '5-FU 2,600 mg/m2 over 24 hr, repeated weekly', given immediately after the leucovorin infusion. Weekly regimen; day shown as 1 of each 7-day cycle.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: per low emetic risk tier, see supportiveCare

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: low emetic risk tier (5-FU/leucovorin, per NCCN Antiemesis guideline categories, Appendix D) - prophylaxis for 10-30% emesis frequency

G-CSF: not routinely indicated; AIO weekly 5-FU/LV is not a high or intermediate febrile-neutropenia-risk regimen per NCCN Appendix C categories - physician discretion if patient-specific risk factors present

monitoring: renal function (dose adjustment context for 5-FU/LV regimens)

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Cancer of the Colon, Table 40.11; lines 123467 (leucovorin), 123472 (5-fluorouracil). Setting/stage/intent from the same chapter's 'Management of Unresectable Metastatic Disease' section (lines 123342 to 123347, 123352), which contains Table 40.11.

guideline.locator: NCCN Colon Cancer v2.2026: COL-D 2 of 17 (metastatic; fluorouracil/leucovorin listed as Less Intensive Therapy, any line of therapy if not previously given) and COL-D 9 of 17 (weekly fluorouracil 2600 mg/m2 by 24-hour infusion plus leucovorin 500 mg/m2, repeat weekly), COL-B (Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review: adenocarcinoma; KRAS/NRAS/BRAF and MMR/MSI testing), COL-2A (metastatic adenocarcinoma workup)

provenanceNote: Regimen dosing is sourced from DeVita 12th ed. Resolved from DeVita 12th ed.: treatmentSetting=metastatic and stage IV from the 'Management of Unresectable Metastatic Disease' section (lines 123342 to 123343 heading; 'unresectable stage IV disease' line 123352) that contains Table 40.11 where this regimen appears; treatmentIntent=palliative from the same section (lines 123344 to 123347). Guideline layer (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Colon Cancer v2.2026) resolves: histology=colorectal adenocarcinoma (COL-B; COL-2A); lineOfTherapy=any line of therapy if not previously given (COL-D 2 of 17, fluorouracil/leucovorin as Less Intensive Therapy); biomarkers=not eligibility-restricted for this cytotoxic backbone, with KRAS/NRAS/BRAF and MMR/MSI testing recommended per COL-B. The exact weekly schedule (fluorouracil 2600 mg/m2 by 24-hour infusion plus leucovorin 500 mg/m2, repeated weekly) is the guideline weekly fluorouracil/leucovorin regimen at COL-D 9 of 17. eligibilityCriteria stays VERIFY (no structured eligibility criteria stated by the guideline for this backbone). No divergence with the core layer. No endorsement is implied; this remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol.
